tasks.short: Investigate fraudulent claims and stolen funds

steps.what: Define investigation scope and verify insurance claims or funds records
Reconcile claims and transactions against specified duplicate and amount checks
Investigate exceptions and corroborate whether claims are fraudulent or funds stolen

tasks.design: Configure repeat comparisons over authorised {ERP} and claim extracts, retaining source references in {DOCS}. An exception prompts investigation; the investigator establishes context and intent before any allegation or client disclosure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated reconciliation can delay investigation without establishing fraud itself.
tasks.enabler_now: Native queries can reproduce explicit duplicate and amount comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Duplicates and unusual payments can have legitimate explanations.
tasks.human_edge: Corroborate intent and actively seek explanations that contradict suspicion.
tasks.altitude: Less reconciliation may leave more time for corroboration; allegation and disclosure authority are unchanged.

reach.task: Trace financial links to source records

evidence.claim: FRISS scores claims with reasons and routes doubtful claims to a person, with support for fact-building; this supports investigation assistance, not an automated fraud finding.
Deterministic reconciliation and its time estimate here are an unmeasured model-knowledge design, separate from claims scoring.

assumptions: Boundary is authorised financial/claims investigation and internal findings, not claim denial, funds recovery or external accusation. Existing source record keeping is outside and unchanged.

Investigator produces mandate/scope, permitted source/version IDs, transaction/claim IDs, dates, amounts, currencies, party/account references, comparison keys and explicit exception rules in s1's retained25 hours, including all extraction verification and structured entry. Client record custodians supply existing originals beforehand. Missing or inconsistent keys require manual reconciliation; no free fraud flag or matched identity is assumed.
Try native queries/export checks before custom code; already automated reconciliation creates zero additional saving. No expanded investigation targets are selected automatically.
Eight focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover rule/schema checks and exceptions; four other-role support hours cover approved extraction configuration.
research_questions: Does repeat reconciliation save time after complete source capture and legitimate-explanation checks?

tasks.short: Obtain and analyze information to solve cases

steps.what: Obtain authorised information on suspects, crimes or disturbances within the case remit
Analyze source information and test explanations for the case

loop.purpose: Propose source-linked chronology and contradictions within a closed authorised source set
loop.input: Versioned source passages, collection context and investigator-defined questions
loop.output: Candidate chronology and conflicting statements with source references
loop.check: Investigator compares wording, speaker attribution, chronology and contrary evidence with originals and independently judges conclusions
loop.stop: One source-set pass and one correction; uncertain identity, missing sources or unreliable attribution use manual analysis
loop.why_not_simpler: Dates can be sorted deterministically, but narrative accounts and contradictions need contextual reading

tasks.design: Keep collection decisions and field work with the investigator, then test a bounded source reader in {DOCS}. It proposes a chronology and contradictions for verification without selecting new targets or deciding criminal activity.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated narrative reading can consume time while still requiring careful source attribution.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded reader can propose passage-linked comparisons within an approved source set.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete retrieval or mistaken identity can produce a convincing false account.
tasks.human_edge: Test alternative explanations and explain the limits of what was lawfully obtained.
tasks.altitude: Some repeated reading may shrink; collection choices and case conclusions remain human.

evidence.claim: Maltego provides OSINT searches and link graphs; that is adjacent retrieval/charting capability and does not validate this narrative-analysis design.
The bounded reader and time estimate are unmeasured model-knowledge assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary covers lawful collection and substantive analysis, not separate report drafting or testimony. Fraud investigation overlap with13106 is assigned once in a roll-up.

Investigator produces case purpose, permitted methods, proportionality rationale, source IDs/versions, collection dates, speaker identities and uncertainties during s1's retained55 hours. Interviewees supply answers during collection before analysis. Missing metadata or access permission leads to manual clarification and analysis; no free reliable-source or criminal-activity flag is assumed.
Try native source search and chronology tools before a bounded reader. Collection scope is approved before each related action within s1, and changed targets/methods require reconsideration.
Seven focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover reader checks and source/template drift; four other-role support hours cover restricted access configuration.
unknowns: Case mix and narrative verification cost
research_questions: Does passage-by-passage verification leave any net reading saving on disputed accounts?

approvals.approved_version: Exact collection target, purpose, method, source scope and applicable permission at each action; changes require fresh approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86.5 gross13.5 minus7 upkeep net6.5. Range0-3 allows difficult identity/attribution cases at0; organised source-complete narratives support a small saving after verification.

steps.what: Testify at hearings or court trials and present evidence with its limitations

tasks.design: Retain live testimony and evidence presentation with the investigator. Existing {DOCS} records support answers without generating a substitute for personal knowledge.
tasks.previous_blocker: The witness must answer the hearing's actual questions and explain evidential limits.
tasks.enabler_now: No new enabler changes the live hearing.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected questions and disputed interpretations need accountable answers.
tasks.human_edge: Say what was observed, what was inferred and what is unknown.
tasks.altitude: Hearing duties and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Live testimony remains human work; report generation does not establish shorter hearing time.

assumptions: Boundary is live testimony and presentation, excluding separately counted collection and report preparation.

Hearing officials produce the request and questions, with questions arriving during testimony before answers. Investigator checks original findings and states uncertainty within retained100 hours; no pre-generated reliable-answer flag is assumed.
Retain native record access before custom tools; no new process is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because testimony and tools are unchanged.
research_questions: Is live hearing time separated from preparation in the workload baseline?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; hearing questions and presentation retain their time.

tasks.short: Question people for sensitive personal investigations

steps.what: Question persons to obtain evidence about custody, missing persons, character or financial status

tasks.design: Keep sensitive questioning with the investigator. Existing {DOCS} notes preserve the person's account without treating a generated summary as evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reliable answers depend on interaction and context.
tasks.enabler_now: No new tool replaces questioning itself.
tasks.still_hard: Family disputes and missing-person cases can involve distress, conflicting interests and incomplete accounts.
tasks.human_edge: Ask non-leading follow-ups and avoid treating a character allegation as established fact.
tasks.altitude: Interview time and responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Sensitive questioning remains human work; no digest capability establishes shorter substantive interviews.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive questioning, not separate report writing or background database checks. Interviews also counted under13097 have one owner in roll-ups.

Existing case intake supplies purpose and scope before questioning; investigator captures source identity, time, actual answers, context and uncertainties during retained100 hours. Interviewee produces the account during the conversation. No pre-existing truth or character flag is assumed; missing detail leads to appropriate follow-up.
Native note access is sufficient before custom tools; no new participant capture duty is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because the interview process remains unchanged.
research_questions: Which interview minutes are substantive interaction rather than separately counted report preparation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Sensitive questioning and follow-up retain their time; easier note access does not shorten the conversation.
